torbox_api_key.label: TorBox API key
torbox_api_key.description: Bearer token from your TorBox account. Used to check caches, add torrents and request direct download links.

prowlarr_url.label: Prowlarr URL
prowlarr_url.description: Base URL of your Prowlarr instance, reachable from the Music Assistant container, for example http://192.168.1.10:9696.

prowlarr_api_key.label: Prowlarr API key
prowlarr_api_key.description: API key from Prowlarr under Settings, General.

preferred_quality.label: Preferred audio quality
preferred_quality.description: Which cached format is preferred when a release exists in several formats. Tracks are matched by title and track number either way.
